quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē (was born) with feminine hēs (of whom) admits both the withheld-father and the birth-narration readings; the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
why: The judge text neither counts verses against each other nor applies the stating-verse test DG-61 retires; it reports the answers given to each witness by chain link and section and reaches UNDERDETERMINED on the admissibility of both readings, so it does not breach K-C.
